sources.note: Neutrik NC3FXX dimension drawing ST-NC3FXX (opened, see the xlr3-f spec): length 71.5 - 73.5 mm, shell 19.2 mm, mating front 15.75 mm, latch lug. The NC5FXX (5-pole female DMX cable connector) uses the same housing as the NC3FXX, so the model has the NC3FXX size and shape with five contact holes instead of three: an assumption (the NC5FXX drawing was not opened; retail listings give no dimensions for it).
Five-pole layout: five contact holes 45 degrees apart on about a 4.6 mm radius over the lower half, key on top; general XLR5 (DMX512) pinout, an estimate. The catalog id xlr5-f matesWith xlr5-m.
